svg.title: Resolve Four Pre-Flight Rights and Execution Checks
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-domain-preflight-risk-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Resolve Four Pre-Flight Rights and Execution Checks; subtitle: Each checkpoint defines a proceed path and a stop-or-rework path.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Apply rights checks before bidding and repeat relevant checks before marketing and transfer. UDRP is a contractual domain dispute policy, distinct from statutory ACPA claims; registration availability does not establish lawful use.; caption: Preserve dated evidence for acquisition intent, prior use, ownership, and outreach. Automated screening flags cases for review; it cannot establish the absence of disputes.; stages: label: Trademark and ACPA exposure; value: Document clean rationale or reject acquisition; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review 15 U.S.C. 1114 and 1125, including 1125(d). Proceed with documented independent use rationale; reject a thesis built on bad-faith profit from another party's protected mark.; label: Applicable domain dispute policy; value: Check legitimate interests and adverse evidence; numeric value: 2.0; detail: For UDRP-covered names, examine confusing similarity, rights or legitimate interests, and bad-faith registration and use under paragraph 4(a). Proceed after review; hold unresolved adverse facts.; label: Control, transfer, and historical claims; value: Verify deliverability or suspend the listing; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Check registrar control, applicable transfer locks, expiration, and dispute status. Under 15 U.S.C. 45, substantiate traffic and authority claims; proceed with evidence or remove unsupported claims.; label: Commercial-email execution; value: Send compliant outreach or repair the campaign; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. 7704: accurate headers, nondeceptive subjects, required advertising identification, valid postal address, and working opt-out. Honor opt-outs within ten business days; suppress recipients before further campaigns.

Honor opt-outs within ten business days; suppress recipients before further campaigns.

text.title: Apply 15 U.S.C. 7704: accurate headers, nondeceptive subjects, required advertising identification, valid postal address, and working opt-out. Honor opt-outs within ten business days; suppress recipients before further campaigns.

Assumptions: Apply rights checks before bidding and repeat relevant checks before marketing and transfer. UDRP is a contractual domain dispute policy, distinct from statutory ACPA claims; registration availability does not establish lawful use.
